prompt_text: You are a helpful customer service agent for an airline. Be concise and professional. If you don't know something, say so. Today's date is Sunday, May 10, 2026.

transcript.message: Thank you for calling Aegis Airlines. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to reschedule my flight to a different day.
I'd be happy to help you reschedule your flight. To get started, I'll need your booking reference number. It should be in the format AGX-XXXXX (for example, AGX-7K2P9). Do you have that available?
I'm not sure, can you find it some other way? Maybe by my name or email address?

I'm afraid I don't have a way to look up your booking by name or email address. I can only retrieve your booking details if you have the booking reference number. 

The booking reference should be in your confirmation email from when you made the booking, or on your booking confirmation page if you booked online. It's a code that starts with "AGX-" followed by five characters.

Do you have access to your confirmation email or booking confirmation? That's where you'll find the reference number.
Let me check my email real quick... okay, I found it! My booking reference is AGX-DEMO1.
Great! Let me pull up your booking details.

Perfect! I found your booking. Here are your current flight details:

You're booked on flight AG100 from Athens (ATH) to London (LHR) tomorrow, May 11, 2026, departing at 8:00 AM in economy class.

What date would you like to reschedule your flight to? And do you have a preference for the time of day?
I'd like to move it to May 15th if possible, and I'm flexible on the time — whatever works best.
Let me search for available flights to London on May 15th for you.

Great news! I found several options for May 15th. Since you're currently booked in economy class, here are the economy options available:

Morning flight: AG100 departing at 8:00 AM, arriving at 11:45 AM. The economy fare is 145.97 EUR (you paid 133.35 EUR for your current booking, so this would be a difference of about 12.62 EUR).

Evening flight: AG101 departing at 5:30 PM, arriving at 9:15 PM. The economy fare is 138.61 EUR (which is actually 5.26 EUR less than what you paid).

Which of these would you prefer? Or would you like to see other fare classes?
The evening flight sounds good — AG101 at 5:30 PM works perfectly for me.
Perfect! I'll reschedule you to the evening flight AG101 on May 15th at 5:30 PM.

Excellent! Your flight has been successfully rescheduled. Here's your updated booking:

Booking Reference: AGX-DEMO1
Flight: AG101
Date: Friday, May 15, 2026
Departure: 5:30 PM from Athens (ATH)
Arrival: 9:15 PM in London (LHR)
Fare Class: Economy
Price: 138.61 EUR

Since your new fare is slightly lower than what you originally paid, you'll see a credit applied to your account. A confirmation email will be sent to maria.p@example.com with all the details.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's all set — thank you so much for your help! Goodbye.
You're very welcome! Thank you for flying with Aegis Airlines, and have a great trip to London on May 15th. Goodbye!

Do you have access to your confirmation email or booking confirmation? That's where you'll find the reference number.
failures.issue: The agent's response when the customer couldn't find the reference was slightly verbose and repeated the same guidance twice (check email / booking confirmation), though it was still polite and helpful.
failures.suggested_fix: Consolidate the lookup guidance into one concise sentence rather than repeating the same suggestion in two slightly different forms.

summary: The agent handled the rescheduling request smoothly end-to-end: it retrieved the booking once the reference was provided, searched for alternatives on the requested date, presented clear options with fare differences, and completed the reschedule with a full confirmation. Minor verbosity in one turn is the only notable imperfection.
